snippet.title: Tjen Folket Media
snippet.description:
TFM er en rød medieplattform. Med slagordene proletarer i alle land, forén dere og det er rett å gjøre opprør som veiledning, vil vi skape medier for sosialistisk revolusjon og nyheter fra kampen.

Som en plattform sprer vi nyheter og tekster som er relevante, ikke fordi vi står ansvarlig for alt innhold i disse. Vi vil ikke bare spre våre egne tekster eller standpunkt, og vi vil heller ikke stå kollektivt til ansvar for alt innhold. Tvert om ønsker vi å utvikle en medieplattform der hundre blomster får blomstre - selv om vår redaksjonelle linje er en rød og maoistisk linje.

Vi vil skape spredning for saker som tjener som verktøy for folk. Verktøy for å forstå verden, og verktøy for å forandre den.

Tjen Folket Media er en rød front organisert på grunnlag av følgende prinsipper:
1. Vi vil bidra til å politisere, mobilisere og organisere folket til kamp og motstand.
2. Vi vil støtte kamp mot kapitalisme og imperialisme, for klassekamp og kommunisme.
3. Vi vil bidra i kamp

snippet.title: Carolina Journal
snippet.description:
Carolina Journal is a leader in investigative journalism in North Carolina. It has exposed corruption, conflicts of interest, and misuse of public funds by public officials, including members of Congress and members of the North Carolina General Assembly. It also has exposed malfeasance on the part of economic developers and nonprofits that receive state and federal funds.

CJ is a pioneer in nonprofit journalism, having published thousands of articles on politics, education, health care, regulations, crime, taxes, and other issues since its founding in 1991. CJ, with a statewide print circulation of more than 40,000, covers state government and the General Assembly, including not only news and investigative stories but also commentary and analysis.

ARY News is a Pakistani news channel launched on 26 September 2004. It is a part of the ARY Digital Network, which is a subsidiary of ARY Group. ARY is an acronym of Abdul Razzak Yaqoob, who was the owner of ARY Group.

ARY NEWS brings you 24/7 Live Streaming, Headlines, Bulletins, Talk Shows, Infotainment, and much more.
Watch minute-by-minute updates of current affairs and happenings from Pakistan and all around the world!

Watch our current affairs and infotainment shows:

- The Reporters with Khawar Ghumman, Chaudhary Ghulam Hussain, Hassan Ayub, Ashfaq Ishaq Satti 
- On My Radar with Kamran Khan 
- KHABAR Muhammad Malick Kay Saath
- 11th Hour with Waseem Badami 
- Sawal Yeh Hai with Maria Memon
- Aiteraz Hai with Aniqa Nisar
- Hoshyarian with Haroon Rafiq
- Sports Room with Najeeb Ul Hasnain
- Bakhabar Savera with Sadaf Abdul Jabbar & Saim Khan

snippet.title: Confidencial
snippet.description:
¡Este es el canal de Confidencial Nicaragua! 📹🇳🇮

Somos la fuente de información y análisis más confiable de Nicaragua. En nuestro canal, dirigido por el periodista Carlos Fernando Chamorro, encontrarás la verdad que la dictadura de Daniel Ortega y Rosario Murillo quieren ocultar:

▪ Cubrimos las últimas noticias de Nicaragua.
▪ Analizamos los hechos más importantes con invitados nacionales e internacionales.
▪ Publicamos reportajes e investigaciones originales.

No te pierdas nuestro programa estelar “Esta Semana”, cada domingo, con Carlos Fernando Chamorro.

Nuestra cobertura incluye temas de política, economía, derechos humanos, migración, documentales históricos, historias de los nicas en el mundo, artistas, poetas, músicos y pintores.

🔔 ¡Suscríbete para estar siempre informado! Activa la campana para no perderte nada.

#Confidencial #Nicaragua #CarlosFernandoChamorro #EstaSemana #LaTertulia #NicasMigrantes #NoticiasDeNicaragua #NicaraguaNoticias #NicaraguaHoy

snippet.title: Laurel Outlook
snippet.description: The Laurel Outlook is the award-winning weekly newspaper covering the cities of Laurel, Park City and Joliet, Montana. For over 100 years, the Outlook has provided readers with all their local, school and community news. From covering tragedy, accidents and crime with sensitivity to celebrating the big games, holidays and achievements of our  outstanding residents with pride, the Outlook is truly a community newspaper.

snippet.title: El Tribuno de Jujuy
snippet.description:
Bievenidos al canal de Youtube de El Tribuno de Jujuy,  en donde todos los días podes informarte, participar y llevarte regalos en vivo a través del servicio de streaming El Tribuno Plus. Por las mañanas de 10 a 12 con El Matutino y por las tardes, de 20:00 a 21hs con Central de Noticias. Además donde encontrarás entrevistas, informes y videos de coberturas especiales. 
Te llevamos toda información de último momento de distintos puntos de la provincia.

Suscribite, activá la campanita de notificaciones 🔔 y enterate de manera gratuita de las principales noticias de Jujuy en video.


📰 Mantenete informado a través del sitio web de noticias más actualizado de Jujuy:
www.eltribuno.com/Jujuy

👍Seguinos en nuestras redes sociales:
👉https://www.facebook.com/eltribunojujuy
👉https://www.instagram.com/eltribunodejujuy/
